titolo: OpenAI's autonomous pipeline patches 948 Linux kernel privilege‑escalation bugs
descr: OpenAI created a self‑running system that identified, validated and fixed 948 local privilege‑escalation flaws in the Linux kernel.
paragrafi: OpenAI announced a new autonomous pipeline that targets security flaws in the Linux kernel.
The system discovered 948 local privilege‑escalation vulnerabilities, a class of bugs that allow attackers to gain higher system rights.
After finding the issues, the pipeline validated each one and generated patches to fix them.
OpenAI’s effort reduces the number of vulnerable code paths, improving the overall security of Linux distributions.
The work demonstrates how AI can be applied to large‑scale software security tasks.
perche: For AI users, the project shows that automated AI tools can enhance system security without human intervention. For developers of free or locally run models, it highlights a benchmark for applying AI to code analysis and patch generation.
